collection.title: Vauxhall Zafira Life 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Zafira Life 2019 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" on the passengers side with a Bayonet arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Zafira Life which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
